notes.title: November update - Bandit camps V1
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:

Fixed memory leak in resource generation.
Fixed memory leak in terrain deformation.
Fixed memory leak in bandit camp spawning.
City spawning bug leading to reduced performance.


New:

- New terrain deformation system for research facility. Leading to better visuals and better performance. 
- Bandit Camps have gotten a visual overhaul. And gameplay overhaul
    - Randomly spawned walls around bandit camps. Either palisades or Czech Hedgehogs
    - More detailed buildings for camps.
    - Randomly spawned loot and clutter inside bandit camps. Weapons, resources and vehicle upgrades.

- Raider AI improved, and movement system replaced with physically based controller.
    - Raiders can now board the vehicle, albeit infrequently and still buggy. 
    - Raiders now correctly follow physics and cannot walk through walls and other objects, and can't walk up cliffs.
    - Raiders in camps will patrol the camp they spawned in, while raiders from vehicle will randomly walk around.



Known bugs:

- Enemy colliders sometime get a bit lost
- Enemies get left behind when The Vehicle drives off while they are on it.
- Options menu in main menu doesn't work right.
- Options menu sometimes break after restarting game.
- Player controller freezes a bit during startup
- Footstep audio doesn't match walked on objects
- No player sliding audio
- Enemies are sometimes blind, and don't seem to detect the player
- Bandit camps sometimes don't correctly deform terrain.




Other:

- Game freezing on startup has been reduced a bit
- Minor performance improvements to various parts, but performance might still be degraded from previous versions due to increased amount of props and objects.

notes.title: October Update - Bandit Camps - MVP 1
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:

- Enemies got dropped off while enemy cars were chasing the player. Now it's only if the cars start circling the vehicle or player
- Turrets couldn't be built
- Couldn't leave Vehicle steering mode with ESC, when you weren't looking at an object closer than 5 meters
- Game crashed if humanoid enemies spawned outside of a navmesh


New:

- Enemy cars will chase player as well
- Health regen for the player, once out of combat for sufficiently long
- Sliding
- Enemy Humanoids will reload their guns once they empty the magazine
- Enemy Humanoids will target player built turrets
- Player built turrets need to fueled with ammo
- Player built turrets target Enemy Humanoids as well now
- New turret ammo resource, can be crafted at the crafting bench
- When harvesting resources with no room inventory it will drop items on the ground
- Bandit Camps - MVP 1
-- Bandit Camps deform the terrain when spawned
-- Resources spawn on Bandit Camps instead of terrain even when deformed.
-- Terrain Navmeshes get regenerated to include Bandit Camps.
- Enemy Humanoids now have a variable accuracy
- Enemy Humanoids have a reaction time before shooting the player. But will remember where they last saw the player for a faster reaction time if the player re-peeks. Additionally they will go to the the last seen position of the player if the player doesn't reappear again


Known bugs:

- Enemies get left behind when The Vehicle drives off while they are on it.
- Footstep audio can be triggered too frequently on The Vehicle, causing other audio to be muted.
- Options menu in main menu doesn't work right.
- Options menu sometimes break after restarting game.
- Player controller freezes a bit during startup



Other:

- Game freezing on startup has been reduced a bit
- Smaller game build
- Vehicle requires power to rotate now
- Vehicle rotates faster at lower speeds
- Performance and memory changes

notes.title: August Update - Pathfinding rework
notes.content:
The entire previous pathfinding implementation has been replaced.

August update - V0.35

Fixed Bugs:

- The player would freeze inside the shooting range


New:

- The entire voxel pathfinding implementation has been replaced for a navmesh based implementation. Leading to much lower memory usage up to ~50% less memory usage, and better performance.

Known bugs:

- Humanoid Raiders can't pathfind across terrain pieces.
- Options menu in main menu doesn't work right.
- Options menu sometimes break after restarting game.
- Player controller freezes a bit during startup
- The fog has become invisible

notes.title: July update
notes.content:
July update - V0.33

Fixed Bugs:

- Full inventory indicator when trying to pick up items
- Footstep sounds when steering the ship
- Terrain spawns inside the research facility, sometimes trapping the player.
- Enemy humanoids jittering and spazzing out when ragdolling
- Volume slider now affects all audio
- Humanoid Raiders can walk inside the research facility
- Player could shoot themselves
- Mouse movement leading to gunsway while inventory was open


New:

- Killing Humanoid raiders drops guns that give ammo
- Research facility will now load and unload based on your resource render distance. Leading to better performance when far away from spawn.
- Vehicle will now turn faster at lower speeds than at high speeds.
- Player can now die, and will respawn at the nearest respawn point. (Usually the Vehicle)
- Death Screen
- First implementation of a firing range in the research facility. Will be reworked later once the gun update rolls around.
- Basic crafting for coal, ammo and replacement guns.
- Snow deformation can be toggled off. Can improve performance.
- Sprinting (Shift key).
- Sprinting consumes stamina when the player is freezing.
- Wielding a gun reduces the player walk and sprint speeds.


Known bugs:

- Humanoid Raiders can't pathfind on terrain or shoot guns. Will be fixed after refactor, or when Unity fixes their bug.
- Options menu in main menu doesn't work right.
- Options menu sometimes break after restarting game.

As well as some various performance improvements, slightly decreased memory usage, minor bug fixes and a slight file size decrease

notes.title: June Update
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:

- Inventory update lag.
- You can no longer gather resources if you are full inventory.
- Inventory slots and the hotbar had a small pixel missmatch.
- Hotbar position changed off of the center if you changed the resolution while playing.
- Shift clicking items across inventories deleted the item, even if all of it couldn't be transferred

New:


- Cities. You can now find ruined cities in the world. NOTE: This is an early first implementation, which is buggy and isn't feature complete. More to come in later updates.
- Metal resource. 
- Power upgrades are more powerful, and will allow the ship to reach higher speed levels.
- Vehicle Steering Mode. No longer do you need to press button in order to control the ship, instead you use the new steering mode and use WASD + Spacebar to control the ship.
- UI Indicator when you can interact with an object or item.
- Items can now be dropped on the ground. Where they can be picked up again by the player or the ship.



Known bugs:

- Terrain sometimes spawn inside the research facility, stopping you from leaving. Restarting usually solves this.
- No full inventory indicator when trying to pickup dropped items.
- Footsteps are played when you're standing still, but steering the ship while it's driving.
- Humanoid Raiders seem to have lost their AI.
- Options menu in main menu doesn't work right.
- Options menu sometimes break after restarting game.

notes.title: May Update
notes.content:
Bit of a larger update, as the game has been ported to Unity 6. Which will bring more features and performance in the future.

Fixed Bugs:

- Turrets aren't built in the middle of hardpoints.
- Closing the inventory while dragging an item, would break the inventory and make that inventory slot unusable.
- Interaction with vehicle control buttons was unpredictable due to jitter.
- It was snowing when inside the research facility.
- You can no longer reload a full gun.
- Vehicle can no longer reverse through walls.
- Vehicle stops producing smoke when furnace is empty.

Changes:

- New snow for the terrain, with much improved deformation.
This means that enemy vehicles will now also deform the snow.
- Vehicle control panel UI has been replaced with physical indicators, solving the jitter.
- When the vehicle gets blocked by a large rock, it will have to reaccelerate.
- The vehicle can now use all upgrades, bringing 7 different upgrades that you can find in the world.
- Begun refactoring resource system to bring more variety. At the moment this brings large blocking resources such as rock arches.
- Tree no longer spawn on rocky terrain.
- Vehicle will slow down if you jump off, to allow you to catch up to it again.
- Started implementing LOD for the terrain, which will improve GPU performance.
- Terrain generation performance has been improved a bunch.
- Item tooltips are larger to fit item descriptions
- Vehicle smoke has been changed a bit

As well as some other minor changes, and performance improvements.



Known bugs:

- Humanoid Raiders seem to have lost their AI.
- The inventory updates too slowly, and shows a ghost resource for a frame. 
- There is a small pixel missmatch between the hotbar inventory slots and the normal inventory slots.
- The hotbar ends up in the wrong position if you change resolution while playing. 
- Options menu in main menu doesn't work right
- Options menu sometimes break after restarting game

notes.title: April update
notes.content:
Fixed Bugs:

Restarting crashes the game.
Terrain can generate inside the research facility.
The Vehicle can spawn below ground
Vsync can't be toggled
Vehicle gets stuck when there are blocking rocks in front of and behind the vehicle.
Quickly moving the resource render distance slider up and down crashes the game.

Changes:

- Refactored the resource spawning system to be more performant, and spawn resource zones in a better way. No longer should resources be able to spawn on top of the player / vehicle. Resources will no longer respawn in previously explored areas.

- You no longer freeze when inside the research facility. Vehicle freezing zone has also been refactored.

- The Vehicle can reverse, with a colour on the speed bar showing the direction you're driving in.

- Terrain snapping for the research facility. It sometimes look a bit weird at the entrance, due to terrain spawning too steeply. will be solved in a later update.

- Terrain generation performance has been improved to be less stuttery, higher framerate during generation, and slightly reduce memory allocation.

As well as some other minor changes, and performance improvements.
Game file size has also been improved a bit.



Known bugs:

There is no falling snow around the player.
Humanoid Raiders seem to have lost their AI.
Vehicle UI jittering.
The inventory updates too slowly, and shows a ghost resource for a frame. 
There is a small pixel missmatch between the hotbar inventory slots and the normal inventory slots.
The hotbar ends up in the wrong position if you change resolution while playing. 
Terrain holes between chunks.
Raiders sometimes never respawn
